_doc: Motion matching (Phase 5). Weights and limits are tuned on the validation sessions with `python -m models.motion_matching tune`.
_include_warmup_doc: Use the warm-up trials as well. The owner's warm-up trials couldn't be told apart from the rest (classifier AUC 0.54, 2026-10-09), and no more sessions will be recorded.
_warp_lowpass_doc: Warped trials are rebuilt from a low-passed copy of the recorded path and rounded to whole pixels once; rounding already-rounded positions again doubles the pixel-step noise. 0 disables. 40 Hz was chosen on the owner's data (2026-10-09, day 1 library -> day 2 test): 20-50 Hz jitter ratio 0.87 and 18/18 key features, against 1.55 and 17/18 at 30 Hz.
